claims.claim: English settlement at Jamestown dates to1607; arrival inMay, fiction set inJune
Virginia Company financed venture with expectation of profit
Region was part of Indigenous Powhatan world, not an empty continent; assistance and conflict both characterized relationships
River water contributed to health problems, among several factors
claims.phrasing: conditional podia trazer doenças; not a diagnosis or sole-cause claim

claims.claim: Carpenters and other trades present in first cohort
claims.limit: Does not authenticate the invented Nico or his particular workday

claims.visual: Final shot labelled days later; one symbolic departing ship, not all3 ships departing together

dramatization: Nico identity, his gestures, wall, grain level in barrel, expressions and chronology of his imagined day are invented narrative, identified on screen
Interior fort buildings and exact arrangement are interpretive, not archaeological survey
Ship proportions, hull/rigging and symbolic vessel motion are illustrative, not authenticated replicas of named ships
Schematic Powhatan village/markers are not a geographic map or exact settlement locations
Period-inspired doublet/breeches/hose/cap preserve character identity; colors and individual garments are not documented portraits
anachronisms_avoided: No modern hoodie zipper, modern trainers, UnitedStates flag, electric tools or tobacco plantation in1607
No English woman presented as member of originalMay1607 cohort
No invented quotations, Indigenous thoughts, Pocahontas romance or claimed eyewitness diary
